exam.title: Microsoft 365 and AI Services Administrator Associate
exam.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Microsoft 365 administration across Entra ID, Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Defender and Purview, plus practical Microsoft 365 Copilot, Agent 365, licensing, identity, data governance, incident response, reporting, PowerShell and Microsoft Graph experience.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Configure and manage Microsoft 365 tenants and workloads
Govern and secure Microsoft 365 tenants and workloads
Manage and secure AI services in Microsoft 365
guide_sections: Section 3 — Agent identity, settings, policy templates, and Purview protection

review.notes: Every subobjective on the beta blueprint page last updated July 27, 2026 is mapped to tenant, workload, identity, authorization, data, agent/tool, security, operational, evidence, failure, and recovery decisions. Three scenarios, nine labs, and 40 checks include Entra Agent ID lifecycle, tenant agent settings, Agent 365 policy templates, Purview scope, and compliance-gap remediation. All 28 cited URLs are reachable. The September 7 watch separates Agent 365 product GA from individual capability status and adds the recurring Copilot release feed.

findings.title: Second-year recovery cadence remains unspecified
findings.evidence: Two-year policy windows coexist with frequency tables ending at 365 days/52 weeks.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Current beta status and preparation limits
findings.evidence: English and no Practice Assessment/current course remain published; duration not visible.
findings.recommendation: Retain beta bounds without inventing timing or GA date.
findings.resolution: Retain beta bounds without inventing timing or GA date.

findings.title: Backup September changes affect old labs
findings.evidence: Recovery windows, granular GA and preview full workload differ from older descriptions.
findings.recommendation: Add current scope and recovery exercise while preserving unresolved cadence.
findings.resolution: Add current scope and recovery exercise while preserving unresolved cadence.

findings.title: Backup membership selection is not uniformly dynamic
findings.evidence: Static filters snapshot membership; dynamic preview reevaluates daily and mailbox exclusions apply.
findings.recommendation: Explain selection modes and shared-mailbox reconciliation.
findings.resolution: Explain selection modes and shared-mailbox reconciliation.

findings.title: Connectivity insights do not establish user entitlement
findings.evidence: Insights describe location/protocol, not user license or device identity.
findings.recommendation: Add service-health notification and WebSocket troubleshooting evidence.
findings.resolution: Add service-health notification and WebSocket troubleshooting evidence.

findings.title: Shared mailbox licensing and sign-in are distinct
findings.evidence: Delegates need licensed mailboxes; direct shared-account sign-in stays blocked.
findings.recommendation: Add access and capacity licensing boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add access and capacity licensing boundaries.

findings.title: Transcript enforcement differs from defaults
findings.evidence: Only-during, during-and-after and Off have separate recording/transcription effects.
findings.recommendation: Replace vague verification placeholder with decision table and compliance caveat.
findings.resolution: Replace vague verification placeholder with decision table and compliance caveat.

findings.title: Channel membership removal can leave direct file access
findings.evidence: Direct file/folder grants are separate from shared-channel membership.
findings.recommendation: Add identity, ownership and residual-grant review.
findings.resolution: Add identity, ownership and residual-grant review.

findings.title: Legacy risk policies retire October 1
findings.evidence: Current procedure migrates separate user/sign-in risk policies with report-only verification.
findings.recommendation: Add migration deadline, remediation constraints and follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add migration deadline, remediation constraints and follow-up.

findings.title: Cowork access comes from spending scope
findings.evidence: Any applicable selecting policy grants access; discovery and small limits do not exclude users.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped access exercise and asynchronous-limit caveat.
findings.resolution: Add scoped access exercise and asynchronous-limit caveat.

findings.title: Spending policies select one whole policy and preserve usage
findings.evidence: Highest per-user limit wins; group move does not reset consumption.
findings.recommendation: Add precedence and carried-consumption arithmetic; review automatic new services.
findings.resolution: Add precedence and carried-consumption arithmetic; review automatic new services.

findings.title: Newer provider procedure supports scoped access
findings.evidence: September 18 provider procedure and September 14 Cowork admin contradict older tenant-only model wording.
findings.recommendation: Use newer dedicated provider scope and distinguish separate data-retention opt-in.
findings.resolution: Use newer dedicated provider scope and distinguish separate data-retention opt-in.

findings.title: Agent policy target follows token subject
findings.evidence: Agent identities support Block-only; agent-user preview and delegated user policies differ.
findings.recommendation: Add identity/flow table and API-key boundary.
findings.resolution: Add identity/flow table and API-key boundary.

findings.title: Sharing controls have narrower scope than their labels
findings.evidence: No users preserves direct Agent Builder sharing; Microsoft agent types remain visible when disabled.
findings.recommendation: Correct settings scope and add answered checks.
findings.resolution: Correct settings scope and add answered checks.

findings.title: Existing instances have a separate one-time template operation
findings.evidence: Newer settings add bulk Apply template, excluding blueprints/AI teammates; older FAQ only describes new activations.
findings.recommendation: Separate ordinary edit from explicit bulk action and add backlog example.
findings.resolution: Separate ordinary edit from explicit bulk action and add backlog example.

findings.title: Custom upload separates validation from publication and deployment
findings.evidence: ZIP upload reviews host, audiences, policies and permissions.
findings.recommendation: Add objective-specific upload sequence and enforcement check.
findings.resolution: Add objective-specific upload sequence and enforcement check.

findings.title: Block, ownership and firewall behavior vary by platform
findings.evidence: Foundry/SharePoint block limits, multiple individual owners and upstream firewall failures are documented.
findings.recommendation: Add scope-aware lifecycle and result verification.
findings.resolution: Add scope-aware lifecycle and result verification.

findings.title: BYO MCP product support and lifecycle remain preview-limited
findings.evidence: Named clients supported; republishing and deletion unsupported.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit approval/consent, support and lifecycle boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add explicit approval/consent, support and lifecycle boundaries.

findings.title: Audit visibility is broader than documented DLP blocking
findings.evidence: Explicit sharing plus VIEW/EXTRACT and generated-label limits apply; human/agent DLP path differs from audit.
findings.recommendation: Add permission gates, output protection and coverage exercise.
findings.resolution: Add permission gates, output protection and coverage exercise.

findings.title: Catalog and blog evidence need bounded claims
findings.evidence: Current paths show 17 modules; old duration absent; public case study is not tenant validation.
findings.recommendation: Qualify runtime and new commercial leads; add original operations worksheet and denominator examples.
findings.resolution: Qualify runtime and new commercial leads; add original operations worksheet and denominator examples.

blog_intake.author: Alex Fleck
blog_intake.notes: Operations worksheet and original inventory reconciliation. Historical Cowork Frontier status qualified by current admin docs; internal metrics not adopted as promises.

offline_checks: Twelve recovery-clock, policy-selection, consumption, template-backlog, permission-set, inventory, adoption and historical catalog arithmetic assertions. No tenant action.

limitations: Two-year Backup recovery windows lack a documented second-year frequency table; shared unresolved MS-102 source gap.
No tenant, mailbox, agent, billing policy, provider opt-in, MCP registration, network probe, restore or infrastructure lab executed.
Two Udemy direct requests blocked; indexed public catalog descriptions do not verify paid content, originality, coverage, runtime or seller certification claims.
Blog main article read; linked videos/internal tenant/scale claims not reproduced. Latest Copilot entry reviewed, not the entire historical release archive.
Same-context AI research and repair; independent human review pending.

validation.execution_boundary: Local validation only; no infrastructure lab executed.
